classification.difficultyReason: Choose auxiliary parallels through two bends to expose the successive angle differences.

spec.description: Two horizontal lines with matching rightward parallel markers. A three-segment zigzag joins the upper-right endpoint to a junction on the lower line. The lower line extends beyond its junction both ways. Labels are 20 degrees at the upper junction, alpha at the inner left bend, 50 degrees at the inner right bend and 30 degrees at the lower junction.
spec.mathematics: Only the horizontal lines are marked parallel. Internal coordinates reproduce the source's illustrative shallow zigzag; printed angle values are authoritative and are not measured from the drawing.
spec.answerVisibility: All four source angle labels visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Construct horizontal lines through the two inner bends, parallel to the marked lines. Let the angle between the middle connector and a horizontal parallel be $u$.

The lower connector makes $30^\circ$ with the parallel at the right bend (alternate angles on parallel lines).
$$\begin{align*}u+30^\circ&=50^\circ\\u&=20^\circ\end{align*}$$
At the left bend, the upper connector makes $20^\circ$ with the horizontal parallel, and the middle connector makes $u$ with it (alternate angles on parallel lines).
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=20^\circ+20^\circ\\\alpha&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete source figure with dashed red horizontal parallels through both internal bends. Red u labels identify the angle made by the middle connector with each auxiliary parallel.
spec.mathematics: At the right bend u + 30 = 50. At the left bend alpha = 20 + u. The solution construction uses exact 20, 40, 50 and 30 degree sectors, with parallel horizontal end arms and auxiliaries.
spec.answerVisibility: Auxiliary lines and u labels appear only in the worked solution.
